An '''unidentified alien''' used its '''pipe-like body parts''' to create unsettling music behind the curtain of [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] asked where the music was coming from, and the creature then emerged from the cut with steam and music protruding from its pipe-like growths, and the Ewoks were startled by its appearance.<ref name="2-16">{{Ewoks|Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)}}</ref>
